problems.title: Recursive factorial
problems.statement: Read an integer n (0 <= n <= 20) and print n! using a recursive function.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: The stopping case only handles n == 1, so factorial of 0 recurses forever.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The factorial is returned as int, which overflows from 13! on.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: The base case stops at 2 instead of 1, so 2! comes out as 1.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: The base case returns 0 instead of 1, so every product collapses to 0.

problems.title: First n Fibonacci numbers
problems.statement: Read n (0 <= n <= 30) and print the first n Fibonacci numbers, starting with 0 and 1, separated by spaces, computed with a recursive function.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Only fib(0) has a stopping case, so fib(1) recurses into negative numbers forever.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Prints fib(i+1) so the sequence is shifted by one position.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop prints n+1 numbers because of <= instead of <.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong recurrence: adds fib(n-3) instead of fib(n-2).

problems.title: Fast power
problems.statement: Read a base a and an exponent b (a^b always fits in a 64-bit integer) and print a to the power b using recursion that halves the exponent.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case only for b == 1, so exponent 0 never stops.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Function uses int, results above 2^31 are lost.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Adds the half power to itself instead of multiplying.

problems.title: Recursive digit sum
problems.statement: Read a non-negative integer n (up to 10^18) and print the sum of its decimal digits using a recursive function.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: No stopping case, so digsum(0) calls itself forever.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: n is read into an int so values above 2^31 are truncated.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Multiplies the digits instead of adding them.

problems.title: GCD and LCM
problems.statement: Read two non-negative integers a and b (not both 0, up to 3*10^9) and print their gcd and lcm separated by a space. Use a recursive gcd.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping test is on the wrong variable, so the recursion ends in a modulo by zero.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The lcm is stored in an int and overflows for large inputs.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Uses a*b as the lcm and forgets to divide by the gcd.

problems.title: Recursive palindrome check
problems.statement: Read one word and print YES if it is a palindrome and NO otherwise, using a recursive helper that compares the outer characters.
tests:
a
aa
ab
abba
abcba
abca
racecar
level
palindrome



bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: No stopping case when the indices meet, so the indices run off the string.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Right index starts at size() so it compares against the terminator.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Returns true on the first matching pair instead of checking all pairs.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong output text, prints Yes instead of YES.

problems.title: Binary search first occurrence
problems.statement: Read n, then n positive integers in non-decreasing order, then a value x. Print the smallest index (0-based) where x occurs, or -1 if it does not occur. Use a recursive binary search.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: No stopping case for an empty range, so a missing value recurses forever.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Search range is 1..n instead of 0..n-1.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Returns the first hit found instead of continuing left for the smallest index.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Comparison reversed so the search goes to the wrong half.

problems.title: Recursive countdown
problems.statement: Read an integer n. Print n, n-1, ..., 1 separated by spaces and then Liftoff! on the same line (just Liftoff! if n <= 0). Use recursion.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case only matches 0, so a negative start never stops.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Stops one step too early so 1 is never printed.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Prints after the recursive call so the numbers come out in the wrong order.

problems.title: Recursive string reverse
problems.statement: Read one line of text (possibly empty) and print it reversed using a recursive function.
tests:
hello
a

ab
abc
Hello World
racecar
madam im adam


bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case misses the empty string so substr runs past the end.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Stops at length 2, leaving the last two characters unreversed.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Puts the first character first again so nothing is reversed.

problems.title: Tower of Hanoi move count
problems.statement: Read the number of disks n (0 <= n <= 62) and print the minimum number of moves to solve the Tower of Hanoi, using a recursive count.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case is only n == 1, so zero disks recurse forever.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Counts moves in an int which overflows for 32 or more disks.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Base case counts one move for zero disks, so every answer is off.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong recurrence, adds n instead of doubling and adding one.

problems.title: Index of last occurrence
problems.statement: Read n (up to 100000), then n positive integers, then a value x. Print the 0-based index of the last occurrence of x, or -1 if x is not present. Use a helper function.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Stops at the first match instead of the last.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Loop in the helper starts at 1 and skips the first element.

bugs.label: CPP_ARRAY_BOUNDS
bugs.note: Array holds 10 elements but the input can have 100000.

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Assignment instead of comparison, so every element is overwritten and matches.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Not-found default is 0, which is a valid index, instead of -1.

problems.title: Sum of the primes
problems.statement: Read n, then n integers (each between 0 and 2147483647). Print the sum of those that are prime. Use a helper function that returns a bool.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Flag is never reset between calls, so after one composite number every later number is judged composite.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Strict comparison skips the square root, so perfect squares of primes look prime.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Wrong lower bound lets 1 count as prime.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Divisor search starts at 3, so even numbers are never tested.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The total of large primes overflows an int.

problems.title: Binary representation
problems.statement: Read a non-negative integer n (up to 10^18) and print its binary representation without leading zeros, using a recursive function.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Condition is always true for n >= 0, so the recursion never stops.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Prints the digit before recursing so the bits come out reversed.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Threshold is 2 instead of 1, so the leading bit is dropped for n = 2 and 4.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: n is read into an int and large inputs are clamped.

problems.title: Collatz step count
problems.statement: Read n (1 <= n <= 1000000) and print how many steps the Collatz process (halve if even, 3n+1 if odd) needs to reach 1. Use recursion.

bugs.label: CPP_MISSING_BASE_CASE
bugs.note: Stopping case is 0, which the sequence never reaches, so it cycles 4-2-1 forever.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: The parameter is int so 3n+1 overflows for some starting values.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Count starts at 1 so every answer is one too big.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgets to count the halving step.
